name: Starboard Protocol
alternateName: Starboard — the Rules of the Orbital Road
description: An open, deterministic give-way protocol for satellite collision avoidance. Two spacecraft from rival operators, with no communication, independently compute the bit-identical verdict about which one maneuvers, from a shared CCSDS Conjunction Data Message. Includes a C++17 reference, an independent MISRA-checked C99 flight library with built-in self-test, SEU-tolerant redundant evaluation and CCSDS telemetry, a flock layer for constellation-wide maneuver awareness, and evidence of bit-identical results across 11 CPU architectures and bare-metal Cortex-M microcontrollers, CBMC proofs and fuzzing.
applicationCategory: Aerospace; Space Traffic Management; Flight Software
